words.example: I asked my counterpart in Radiology to check the referral date.
words.exampleZh: 我请放射科的对口同事核对转诊日期。

words.example: A colleague in Finance explained why the invoice was rejected.
words.exampleZh: 财务的一位同事解释了这张发票被退回的原因。

words.example: Tell your supervisor before you agree to cover an extra shift.
words.exampleZh: 答应多顶一个班次之前，先告诉上级主管。

words.example: The manager wants the overtime figures before the quarterly review.
words.exampleZh: 经理希望在季度回顾之前拿到加班数据。

words.example: The team lead will run the briefing if the supervisor is in clinic.
words.exampleZh: 如果主管在门诊，简报就由组长来主持。

words.example: Bluetooth on the vital-signs cart keeps pairing with the wrong pump.
words.exampleZh: 这台生命体征推车上的蓝牙老是配到错误的泵。

words.example: The VPN client on the home laptop cannot reach the order system.
words.exampleZh: 家里那台笔记本上的虚拟专网客户端连不上医嘱系统。

words.example: Split tunnel lets clinic browsing go direct while orders stay on our network.
words.exampleZh: 分流隧道让门诊浏览直接出去，医嘱流量仍走我们的网络。

words.example: Full tunnel sends even ordinary clinic browsing through the hospital.
words.exampleZh: 全流量隧道把门诊普通的网页浏览也送进了医院。

words.example: The MFA prompt never reached the doctor because her phone was in the operating room.
words.exampleZh: 二次验证提示没有送到医生那里，因为她的手机在手术室。
